# Auto-generated by the projectmake utility
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(gdsims VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
add_compile_options(-O3 -Wall)

# create executable in current directory
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

#find all source files
file(GLOB_RECURSE ALL_SOURCES "src/*.cpp")
list(FILTER ALL_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX ".build/.*")
set(CORE_SOURCES ${ALL_SOURCES})
# Some extra complexity for the catch2 unit testing setup
#exclude some files from core sorces (main excluded as catch2-autogenerates)

list(FILTER CORE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "src/main.cpp")
list(FILTER CORE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "src/test/.*")
file(GLOB_RECURSE TEST_SPECIFIC_SOURCES "src/test/*.cpp")
add_executable(gdsims src/main.cpp ${CORE_SOURCES})

# Only download/build Catch2 if ENABLE_TESTS is passed
option(ENABLE_TESTS "Build tests" OFF)

if(ENABLE_TESTS)
    include(FetchContent)
    FetchContent_Declare(
      Catch2
      GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2.git
      GIT_TAG        v3.12.0
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(Catch2)

    file(GLOB_RECURSE TEST_SPECIFIC_SOURCES "src/test/*.cpp")
    add_executable(gdsims_test EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ${CORE_SOURCES} ${TEST_SPECIFIC_SOURCES})
    target_link_libraries(gdsims_test PRIVATE Catch2::Catch2WithMain)
    target_compile_definitions(gdsims_test PRIVATE UNITTEST)
endif()
